name: player_reset_damage_state_and_timed_hit_status
description: Player::ResetDamageStateAndTimedHitStatus reloads damage material state, clears player damage flags, and delegates timed-hit cleanup to PlayerTimedHitStatus.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; coverage is functional through native Player damage-state tests.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x439990 validates saveState->playerState access, rootNode forwarding to zClass_Node::LoadFlagBit8MaterialImagesAndTexturePack, zeroing damageProtectionActive, queuedFixedDamageFlag, and damageVisualFlag, and calling PlayerTimedHitStatus::ClearLightAndReset.
The native Player damage-state smoke verifies the three damage flags are cleared and preserves the accepted no-light timed-hit cleanup behavior.
